subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow a model-callable `clear_goal` tool to clear terminal or paused session goals and archive them in canonical session state, or should clearing remain operator/session-only?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally reserve clearing to `/goal` and reset commands, while the proposal would add model authority plus a new persistent session-history contract.

options.title: Keep clearing operator-only
options.body: Preserve the documented boundary and explore only non-destructive model signals, such as asking the operator to clear or archive a completed goal.

options.title: Approve a narrow `clear_goal`
options.body: Allow a model-callable tool only for a maintainer-approved status set, with bounded canonical history and full metadata/docs/proof coverage.

options.title: Defer to a broader goal lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open as design context until maintainers settle archive retrieval, reset/deletion behavior, and state-retention policy together.

recommendation.title: Keep clearing operator-only
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented boundary and explore only non-destructive model signals, such as asking the operator to clear or archive a completed goal.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current core goal feature and has the strongest current history on the goal store, model tools, docs, and recent goal UI lifecycle work.
